* '''Playtest''' (this page, 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 1 August 2019: [[:File:V11-L-takodana-20190801.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e26d0f1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/takodana.gif Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “During your deploy phase, if you just deployed a Maz's Castle location, may draw top card of Reserve Deck.” Dark Side: “If you just deployed a starship here, may shuffle any deck or pile.” The lower-left margin prints “Endor (Light)”.
* '''Original''' ([[Takodana]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-L-takodana-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d24ffc3/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/takodana.gif Holotable commit d24ffc3 “Flipped sites”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “During your deploy phase, if you just deployed a Maz's Castle location, may draw top card of Reserve Deck.” Dark Side: “If you just deployed a starship here, may shuffle any deck or pile.” '''What changed:''' before release: the lower-left margin (underlying card) “Endor (Light)” became “Ralltiir (Light)”; re-rendered with sharper graphics; same words.
*: [[File:V11-L-takodana-20190802-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''

Players Committee card image, 29 March 2023: [[:File:V11-L-takodana.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/168657a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/hires/takodana.png Holotable commit 168657a “Set 11 Remastered”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “During your deploy phase, if you just deployed a Maz's Castle location, may draw top card of Reserve Deck.” Dark Side: “If you just deployed a starship here, may shuffle any deck or pile.” '''What changed:''' Set 11 remaster: same words; the art credit “Image courtesy of NetRaptor” moved to the left edge; re-rendered at high resolution (new credit line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”).
